- Total revenue TW was £56.2k against £60.6k LW, a WoW change of -7.3%.
- Total revenue TW of £56.2k compares with £19.8k LY, a YoY change of +183.2%.
- Total units TW reached 22,091 across 1,675 orders, with units down 17.8% WoW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER led TW at £3.0k, a 5.4% share of total revenue, ahead of PARTY BUNTING at £2.3k and 4.1% share.
- BLACK RECORD COVER FRAME and WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER each held 3.0% share TW, at £1.7k and £1.7k respectively, with SPOTTY BUNTING at £1.3k and 2.4% share.
- The top five products together accounted for 18.0% of total revenue TW.
- ORANGE TV TRAY TABLE rose 18,500.0% WoW, FAIRY TALE COTTAGE NIGHTLIGHT rose 7,792.3% WoW and CAMOUFLAGE DESIGN TEDDY rose 5,979.4% WoW.
- SMALL POPCORN HOLDER fell 87.3% WoW, HEART OF WICKER LARGE fell 75.1% WoW and LUNCH BAG RED RETROSPOT fell 71.9% WoW.
